notes: HOTBOX HORDE batch D (burnouts): SHIELD BEARERS (flank them), THROWERS (rocks at your walls), NESTS on the rifts in DEFEND missions and raids - shoot them to close the rift
Mini-bosses: THE BIG BAKED (wave 3) and THE COUGHER (wave 4)
ELITE burnouts (gold smoke): FAST, ARMOURED or REGEN
THE ROOT KING: the boss of the raid to base level 5
LOOT ORBS: killed burnouts sometimes drop crafting materials or a seed packet - walk over them
